Privacy Policy

Who We Are

Flight Wellness is a concierge IV therapy and wellness service based in Abuja, Nigeria. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy.

What Information We Collect

We collect only the information you voluntarily provide when booking a consultation or session: your name, WhatsApp number, email address, location in Abuja, your wellness goals, and any optional health notes you choose to share.

How We Use Your Information

Your information is used solely to confirm and deliver your booking, personalise your wellness plan, and communicate with you about your session. We do not sell, share, or distribute your personal data to any third parties.

How We Store Your Information

Booking details are securely stored in our internal records. We use industry-standard security practices to protect your data from unauthorised access.

Your Rights

You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you, to request correction of any inaccurate data, and to request deletion of your data at any time. To exercise any of these rights, contact us via WhatsApp.

Contact

If you have any questions about this policy, please reach out via our WhatsApp number or Instagram page.

Last updated: April 2026

Terms of Service

Acceptance of Terms

By booking a consultation or session with Flight Wellness, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

Our Services

Flight Wellness provides concierge IV hydration therapy, wellness infusions, and vaccination services delivered to your home, hotel, or office in Abuja, Nigeria. All services are administered by certified registered nurses.

Booking and Confirmation

A booking request is confirmed only after you receive direct confirmation from our team via WhatsApp. We reserve the right to decline a booking if we are unable to accommodate your request at the requested time or location.

Health Disclosure

You are responsible for disclosing any known allergies, medications, or health conditions before your session. Flight Wellness is not liable for adverse reactions resulting from undisclosed health information.

Cancellations

Please notify us at least 4 hours before your scheduled session if you need to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations may affect future booking priority.

Limitation of Liability

Flight Wellness and its nurses will take all reasonable care during your session. We are not responsible for outcomes resulting from pre-existing health conditions not disclosed at the time of booking.

Changes to These Terms

We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

Our Founder

Built on science.
Driven by results.

Chinyelumaka Cynthia Penelope (Nurse Pen) is a Philippines-trained registered nurse and the founder of Flight. After years in clinical practice, she saw the gap most people live with: wanting to feel well but unable to access the care to make it happen.

Flight was built to close that gap. Hospital-grade care delivered by certified nurses, right to your door. No waiting rooms, no guesswork. The right treatment, built around your body and your schedule.

Her vision goes further. Flight is building a network of certified wellness nurses committed to making preventive care something every person in Nigeria can access with confidence.

Chinyelumaka Cynthia Penelope (Nurse Pen)
